summary: Pulls live scores, standings, rosters, player/team stats, and betting odds via the Crawlora API — ESPN (most sports/leagues), SofaScore (global soccer + more), MLB's own stats API, Strava (routes, clubs, challenges), and DraftKings Sportsbook (moneyline/spread/total odds, futures, live events) — returning clean JSON. Use when the user wants a live scoreboard, a team or player's stats, league standings, a game's boxscore/play-by-play, head-to-head history, sportsbook odds, or an endurance-sport route/club.
